message.content: On April 3rd, 2026, Alice is delivering the bread to Li Hua. This is evident from the conversation where HaileyJohnson mentions, "Hey Li Hua! Just a quick reminder that Alice is on her way to deliver your fresh bread this morning. Enjoy! 🥖💖" and LiHua confirms, "Thanks for the heads up! Always excited for some fresh bread. Can't wait to try it! 😋".
